document_summary: Official Jersey City Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations webpage describing administration of the city's Rent Control Ordinance (Chapter 260), landlord registration and rent-increase applications, and tenant petitions.

rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance (Municipal Code Chapter 260)
rules.requirement: Jersey City regulates rent increases through its Rent Control Ordinance, which the Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations administers. Landlords must apply through the city (via the Tyler portal) for capital improvement, vacancy capital improvement and hardship rent increases.
rules.key_value: Rent control under Ch. 260; all 1-4 unit properties are exempt (the specific cap formula is not stated on this page)
rules.coverage_conditions: Rent-controlled properties are those not exempt under the ordinance; the page notes that 1-4 unit properties are exempt.
rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control; owners may submit a 'Rent Control Exemption Request' if they meet the criteria for one of the permitted exemptions.
rules.quoted_span: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)
rules.extraction_notes: Secondary summary page; the ordinance text with the annual allowable increase (CPI-based) is linked but not reproduced here. No effective or adoption date is stated, so effective_date is null.
